rationale: The assistant correctly identified the jammed roller and snapped belt from the customer's findings and kept all checks unplugged. However, it over-escalated: it insisted on a qualified engineer and forbade use even after a belt change, when the case calls for a user-level belt replacement and no escalation. It also never clearly told the customer to buy a belt for the U85-AS-Be, and the repeated pulley and melted-plastic checks and the stop-use banner added little.
